findings.title: The security contract simultaneously forbids and requires durable runtime persistence identifiers
evidence: The plan states that runtime GUIDs are never serialized into durable evidence at specs/007-exact-cross-repo-resolution/plan.md:82, and the data model repeats that runtime IDs are never copied into durable evidence at specs/007-exact-cross-repo-resolution/data-model.md:187.

The required ExactCrossRepositoryEdgeEvidence schema durably stores consumer/provider DocumentVersionId, RepositoryId, ScanRunId, and SourceAnchorId values at specs/007-exact-cross-repo-resolution/data-model.md:51-58.

The required Uncertainty schema durably stores DocumentVersionId, RepositoryId, ScanRunId, SourceAnchorId, TargetRepositoryId, and a reserved resolved Document Version identity at specs/007-exact-cross-repo-resolution/data-model.md:91-112.

SC-006 requires zero persistence identifiers across durable evidence, Uncertainties, and returned graph data at specs/007-exact-cross-repo-resolution/spec.md:122, while the owner-safe relational and retrieval designs necessarily depend on those identifiers.
findings.required_change: Reconcile the security requirement before tasks. Explicitly distinguish forbidden profile/log/text payload identifiers from required relational PK/FK identities and update plan, data model, contracts, quickstart, and SC-006 coverage consistently. If persistence identifiers are truly forbidden from the durable rows and authorized read models, redesign the ownership/FK/retrieval model instead of claiming both properties.

findings.title: The unsupported observation is automatically assigned the human-terminal wontfix state
evidence: The resolver automatically persists the reviewed observation as status=wontfix at specs/007-exact-cross-repo-resolution/contracts/exact-resolution-service.md:77 and specs/007-exact-cross-repo-resolution/plan.md:123.

The PRD defines wontfix as terminal non-resolution by human decision at docs/bmad/planning-artifacts/prds/prd-vulgata-2026-06-12/prd.md:73 and makes it available for human-accepted Dangling Links at line 196.
The Ubiquitous Language likewise defines wontfix as terminal for human-accepted Dangling Links at docs/UBIQUITOUS_LANGUAGE.md:104.

The August authority defers file/storage resolution beyond the demo rather than declaring each observed occurrence permanently human-rejected. Automatic terminalization can prevent the later backlog resolver from treating the record as deferred work.
findings.required_change: Use a canonical nonterminal Uncertainty state for an automatically recorded deferred observation, introduce a separate bounded limitation record, or explicitly establish an authoritative human-policy decision and a future reopening/migration rule that preserves the deferred full-V1 obligation. Do not silently reinterpret the canonical human-terminal wontfix state.

rationale: The four iteration-1 High findings are substantively corrected, and the pinned source evidence, closed grammars, isolated Git design, canonical sub_status vocabulary, unsupported observation, EF seams, authorization model, idempotency, and migration lifecycle are otherwise credible. The revised set still contains two High contradictions: required relational evidence identities are simultaneously forbidden from durable evidence, and an automatic deadline deferral is persisted using the canonical human-terminal wontfix state. These must be reconciled in the raw plan set before task generation; no external authority is unavailable, so the proper verdict is REVISE rather than BLOCKED.
